The introduction pathway interacts with minimum residence time (mrt) in affecting the success of non-native plant species in Catalonia. Specifically, species introduced unintentionally show a stronger positive relationship between mrt and invasion success compared to those introduced through Gardening or AgriForest pathways. This suggests that the mode of introduction and the time since introduction both play critical roles in determining the success of non-native plant species in the region.
